title: Client data authenticity verification method, medium and device based on federated learning
assignee: Zhejiang Non Line Digital Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Verification of client data authenticity in federated learning scenario, where the central client cannot determine the authenticity and reliability of local client data.
pse.solution_function: Method for verifying the authenticity of client data by collaboratively training a global model using features and labels of all participants' data. The global model aggregates local information to authenticate client data.
pse.solution_structure: Mixed dataset, local models (for each participant), FedMix algorithm, cosine similarity calculation, weighted aggregation mechanism
pse.solution_implementation: Step S1: Construct mixed dataset by determining the number of samples and combining global data with locally determined labels. Step S2: Train client's local model using local data with different reliability labels. Step S3: Utilize FedMix algorithm for training and optimization to handle data heterogeneity issues. Step S4: Calculate cosine similarity between the client model gradient and the global model gradient in each training round, obtaining the client model as the weight of the global aggregation. Step S5: Aggregate local model parameters from all participants through weighted aggregation. Step S6: Determine the authenticity of client data based on global information.
pse.effect: Reduced risk of malicious behavior, data bias, unreliable gradient updates, and data leakage in federated learning scenarios
